simple.meaning: דּוּב (dûwb) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to mope , i.e. (figuratively) pine.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 1 time across Leviticus, beginning at Leviticus 26:16. Its meaning is built by comparing the passages where Scripture uses it.

firstOccurrence.englishText: I also will do this to you: I will appoint terror over you, even consumption and fever, that shall consume the eyes, and make the soul to pine away. You will sow your seed in vain, for your enemies will eat it.

definitions.full: H1727. dub [ דּוּב ] verb pine away (compare דאבון דאב, ) — Hiph`il Participle feminine plural נפשׁ מְדִיבֹת Lev 26:16 (diseases) causing to pine away the soul (life), compare Di; in 1Sam 2:33 read probably Infinitive נפשׁך את לְהָדִיב (for לַאֲדִיב ᵑ0 ) so Dr; transitive to cause thy (al. his) soul to pine away (compare VB).
